messages:
sarah_support: Hey team — customer Apex Payments (acct: apex-pay) just flagged an invoice we closed yesterday that has no PO number on it. They paid via card but need a PO on the invoice for their internal reconciliation. Can ops/finance advise reissue/credit path?

mike_billing: Thanks Sarah. Do we have the invoice ID and payment confirmation? If it was fully paid we generally do a credit + reissue with new invoice containing the PO.

sarah_support: Invoice: INV-2026-0419-7723, payment_txn: tx_8f7a4b, settled 2026-03-15T17:22Z. Customer provided PO: APX-PO-9921 and says they need it in the invoice PDF and metadata.

raj_engineering: I pulled the invoice document metadata from the billing API — the `po_number` field is null for that invoice. Looks like the frontend checkout didn't include the `po_number` param for that session. Here's the API log snippet: 

```
POST /v1/invoices
payload: { "customer_id": "apex-pay", "amount": 12450, "currency": "USD", "metadata": {}}
response: 201 INV-2026-0419-7723
```

No `metadata.po_number` present.

julia_finance: Ok — standard flow is: issue a credit memo for the paid invoice (zero out the paid invoice), then create a new invoice with same line items + `po_number` APX-PO-9921 and apply the existing payment to the new invoice via rebill rules. Finance needs approval from accounting manager for out-of-cycle credits; I'll queue it.

sarah_support: Customer asked if we can "edit" the invoice to add the PO instead of credit/rebill — is that possible? They have an audit requirement but prefer minimal disruption.

mike_billing: We don't edit issued & settled invoices for audit reasons. The only safe path is credit + reissue or issuing a separate credit note referencing the PO and keeping original invoice for records. For their ERP, reissue is usually accepted.

julia_finance: Will proceed with credit + reissue unless legal flags it. Filing ticket to accounting: ACC-7782. Estimated turnaround: 24–48 business hours. I need confirmation of the exact PO string to include, billing contact, and whether they want the same invoice number pattern or a new one referencing original.

sarah_support: Confirmed PO string: APX-PO-9921. Billing contact: finance+apex@apexpay.com. They prefer a new invoice that references the original invoice number in the memo.

raj_engineering: For future prevention, we should add a validation on the checkout path to reject finalize if `requires_po` flag is true but no `po_number` provided. I can add a quick check and an event metric so we can alert when this happens. Putting a GH PR in for the change.

mike_billing: Thanks. Julia — can you also include a note in the credit/reissue describing the reason ("PO added per customer request; original invoice INV-2026-0419-7723 credited") so their ERP maps correctly?

julia_finance: Will do. I'll CC finance+apex and put invoice-bot to post updates. Targeting credit creation now, will update thread when done.

invoice-bot: ACC-7782 status updated: credit_memo_created by julia_finance at 2026-03-16T09:40Z; new_invoice: INV-2026-0419-7723-R1 (contains PO APX-PO-9921). Payment re-applied.

sarah_support: Forwarding this to the customer now. Closing loop once they confirm receipt in their ERP. :white_check_mark:
